Gorham Bike & Ski Saco Tuesday Night Gravel Ride

Saco, ME

Gorham Bike & Ski Saco Tuesday Night Gravel Ride is a gravel group ride in Saco, ME. It meets Tuesdays, 6:00 pm, mid-April until the light runs out, starting at Gorham Bike & Ski, Saco. Pace: moderate.

About the Gorham Bike & Ski Saco Tuesday Night Gravel Ride group ride

A moderate-pace mixed-surface ride from the Saco shop: pavement, dirt, and a few singletrack sections thrown in. Gravel bikes suggested, anything welcome. The same shop runs a Wednesday no-drop ride from Clifford Park in Biddeford.
